answer: Agents prove unique lineage by reconstructing a shared ancestral fitness ridge from deep mutational scanning, so each identity must occupy a distinct sequence ledge rather than clone a crowded grove of near-identical variants. Colluding sybils that reuse one resurrected lineage collapse onto the same narrow ledge and are flagged when their mutational profiles fail. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
